attBesluta.text: Super capră a ajuns devreme este robustă și își face treaba pentru care este proiectată
Budget friendly! Good quality. Don’t really understand what the issue is with the assembly. Similar to ikea …just look real close at the parts pictures. Took me 8 min.
Works great. Instructions are ambiguous with diagrams only, so make sure you take the time to identify the shape and arrangement of the parts rather than plunging in and attempting a cold assembly.
Folds up small for storage. Holds heavy timber no bother.

Easy to put together and works great. I use it all the time. Folds up easily and can be transported. The only downfall is that sometimes, I have to put my foot on it to keep it steady when cutting larger pieces. While I blame my chainsaw more than the device, it still happens. All in all, I like it and would buy it again.
Easy to assemble. Easy to attach to mower. Does the job with no issues.
Looks like it is built heavy duty and should work well. I did not try it out easy very easy to put together.
I haven't gotten to the point in my pasture where I need to roll it yet, but like all the other Items I've purchased from Vevor, it's well made.
Is equal or even better than the qualities you could buy at any local hardware store. For at least 40% less yes I would highly recommend it.
Easy to assemble and use. Behind my lawn tractor it did exactly what I wanted to my paddocks.

Higher quality drum than I expected. Would have given 5star except it’s on the light side 340lbs, when filled with water, wished they offered a 500lb version in the same style. Draw bars are thick and very strong. Hitching pin and mechanism is a little on the light side (not heavy duty). After 1st use I’m happy with this roller, again I just wished it was heavier.
Easy to unfold and sturdy enough for heavy duty 4 wheelers! Safety rating 10/10.
Great value and quality, I wish it came with safety chains instead of the cloth tether.
Placement of ski glides is quite wide but ramps work and straps are cheap
These are so good I ordered another set for my shop!
Great product very sturdy and allowed me to stabilize my camper extremely well.
Haven't used them yet. They look and feel like good quality.
Blocks are excellent, easy to set and improve trailer stability, good value for the price
They have helped get rid of the trailer shake by shortening the stroke of the leveling jacks
Easy to install, work great and the black finish is nice touch of class. They do accept other brands E Track tie downs.
These worked perfect, couldn't be happier. Bought them for my trailer to tie down my SxS. They were easy to install and did exactly what I expected.
I’ve outfitted multiple trailers with the VEVOR tracks. They have the absolute best price. They hold the weight and pressure with absolutely no issues at all!
Excellent value and strength. The coating is nice and they are packaged well. No issues at all. Comes with fasteners

I got this so I could even cuts of soap for my small business. The cutting wires are too loose to cut well upon arrival. So definitely check them before you use them. It sized the soap bars well, but doesn’t cut the whole way through so you have to pull bars up to finish the cut. Also the wood crease thing fierce cutting the tallow soaps I make, which I know are harder, but they cut find with the hand cutter I got in a kit. I am still figuring out how tight wires should be to do the job well, without feeling like I’m gonna break the wood. I use it, it gets the job done. It seams sturdy at first, so I suppose if your soap are soft at the beginning of curing this would be magnificent!!! It’s not the not the worst, and I have not clue what soap cutters go for anywhere else. I’m would say it does its job sufficiently. I do love that it came with tools to rewire it, and an extra set of wires!!!
jediný klíč na trhu s takto širokou škálou využití na různé průměry. velmi kvalitní provedení - prakticky nezničitelný.. děkuji za rychlé dodání..
Great wrench! It worked very well for us on hydraulic cyclinders, couldn’t ask for a better tool!!!!!!

This chain pipe wrench is a powerful tool for pipe connections and repairs. The chain grips securely around pipes of various sizes, preventing slipping during operation. The long handle provides excellent leverage, allowing me to apply high force without much effort. It’s made of high-quality steel that is sturdy and durable, resistant to corrosion and wear. It’s ideal for plumbers and DIYers who need to work with pipes in their home or workshop.

I’m very satisfied with this chain pipe wrench. The chain is flexible and can adapt well to irregular pipe shapes, making it more versatile than traditional pipe wrenches. It’s easy to use, even with one hand, and holds the pipe firmly without damaging it. The handle is comfortable to hold and provides a good grip, ensuring safe operation. It’s a must-have tool for anyone who works with pipes regularly.
Awesome product, easy to use and well made. Very impressive for the price
Livraison rapide Matériel semble correspondre à mes attentes, reste plus qu'à l'utiliser sur chantier.
Una magnifica y gran llave, para trabajos de gran envergadura de tuberías grandes. Cómoda de manejar y hecha de buena calidad.
